findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** direct: specialise the Bishop upper bound to $k=0$, where $\operatorname{Ric}\ge0=(n-1)\cdot0\cdot g$, and evaluate the integral defining the flat model volume.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** locate the antipode as the cut-time endpoint, solve the scalar Jacobi equation in constant positive curvature, bound the endpoint-vanishing space by an initial-derivative injection into $v^\perp$, and match it with the $n-1$ normal zero modes.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** obtain the total curvature $4\pi$ for every metric from metric independence and the round sphere, then compute the spheroid metric explicitly to exhibit nonconstant pointwise curvature.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** minimizing times are read off as distance equalities; upper semicontinuity contradicts minimality at a fixed later time, and lower semicontinuity uses local invertibility of $\exp_p$ plus the two-minimizer alternative at a hypothetical drop.

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The item gives an explicit normal-addition map and exact shell image; a schematic makes this geometric map easier to read. Existing prose and inverse already prove the claim.
diagram_candidates.content: 2D cross-section schematic of general S^n: draw the unit sphere and concentric radii 1/2 and 3/2, mark normal coordinate t in (-1/2,1/2), show E(p,t)=(1+t)p to the shell, and label x↦(x/||x||,||x||−1) as inverse. State that the cross-section is schematic for all n.

existing_diagram_checks.limitations: All assigned screenshots and ItemBody content were reviewed. No authored TikZ/TikZ-CD or rendered diagrams occur in this lane, so there are no existing diagram maps, orientations, indices, or signs to check.
